title: The Oxygen Was Disappearing Inside Biosphere 2
asof: Figures from 1991–1994 records · full video on the channel

shots.s: Eight people were sealed inside, and the oxygen started vanishing.
This is Biosphere 2, in Arizona, in the early nineteen-nineties.
Outside, air is about twenty-one percent oxygen.
By early 1993, it was down to about fourteen and a half.
Like living fourteen or fifteen thousand feet up a mountain.
The crew was tired all the time.
Some kept stopping breathing in their sleep.
But if something was using up the oxygen,
carbon dioxide should have piled up.
First culprit: the rich farm soil.
Microbes in it ate the oxygen and made carbon dioxide.
It soaked up the carbon dioxide, and hid the evidence.
In 1993, oxygen was pumped in from outside.
